title: Dinner plans changed
instructions: Selin eşine kısa bir mesaj bırakıyor. Değişen plana dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Hi, it's me. My mum just called. She wants us to have dinner at her house tonight.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I'll meet you there at seven. Can you buy some flowers on the way?
